_comment: New entries for dictionary.json 'attributes'. Verified against ocsf-schema main 2026-08-11: none of these names exist yet ('charter' already EXISTS as a file object and is deliberately NOT redefined — the charter digest rides ai_agent.charter.hashes[]). 'fingerprint', 'name', 'uid', 'version', 'type', 'type_id', 'ai_model' are existing entries reused by the new objects, not redefined here.

declared_configuration.caption: Declared Configuration
declared_configuration.description: The declared half of an AI agent's trust base: the model and digest-anchored artifacts the agent is configured to run, as asserted by its registry, manifest, or control plane.

executed_parameters.caption: Executed Parameters
executed_parameters.description: The executed half of an AI agent's trust base: the parameters actually enforced and observed in the executing process.

artifacts.caption: Artifacts
artifacts.description: A list of digest-anchored agent trust-base artifacts.

credentials.caption: Credentials
credentials.description: References to credentials reachable by an executing process — identifiers and scopes only, never credential material.

sampling.caption: Sampling Parameters
sampling.description: The sampling parameters applied to model invocations.

tool_allowlist.caption: Tool Allowlist
tool_allowlist.description: The tool names an executing process will actually permit, as enforced.

tools_invoked.caption: Tools Invoked
tools_invoked.description: The tool names invoked so far in a session, in first-invocation order.

scopes.caption: Scopes
scopes.description: The scopes or permissions granted to a credential.

temperature.caption: Temperature
temperature.description: The sampling temperature applied to a model invocation.

top_p.caption: Top-p
top_p.description: The nucleus (top-p) sampling value applied to a model invocation.

top_k.caption: Top-k
top_k.description: The top-k sampling value applied to a model invocation.

max_output_tokens.caption: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: The maximum output token limit applied to a model invocation.

seed.caption: Seed
seed.description: The sampling seed applied to a model invocation, when the runtime supports seeded decoding.
